name: Reservation of 1 TiB, which fits the address space on every host here
component: ground-truth pairing for RS-VM-0026, where fitting is not sufficient
required_postconditions: a reservation of 1099511627776 bytes is granted

failure_sink.description: the case reports `refused` with the errno the kernel gave, and the runner fails the pairing against a SUPPORTED prediction

extraction_limitations: Single-claim contract written to pair with a ground-truth case. It asserts exactly one thing so that a whole-contract verdict can be compared against a single observation without ambiguity.
x_groundtruth: THE SAME CONTRACT ON TWO HOSTS, and that is the point. 1 TiB is 2^40: far below max_user_address on every host this project measures, so RS-VM-0021's fits-in-the-address-space reason is silent in both lanes and cannot be what decides the verdict. What decides it is the measured max_single_reservation. Unconstrained, the host grants ~2^46 and the answer is SUPPORTED and the kernel agrees. Under RLIMIT_AS the host grants 2^31 and the answer is UNSUPPORTED/PROVEN through RS-VM-0026 alone, and the kernel refuses with ENOMEM. Both pairings hold, for opposite reasons, from one contract. That is the divergence T-015 needed and it required no particular hardware.
